question: A cow is grazing with a rope around her neck and the other end of the rope is tied to a pole. The length of the rope is 10 metres. There are two boundary walls perpendicular to each other, one at a distance of 5 metres to the east of the pole and another at a distance of \(5\sqrt2\) metres to the north of the pole. Find the area the cow can graze on.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
